issues.description: The problem statement text (task description) refers to attributes named 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents', while the UML diagram and the solution implementation use the more explicit identifiers 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents'. This inconsistent naming of the same conceptual attributes may cause minor confusion for students when mapping the textual task to the UML/tests/implementation (they may wonder which exact identifier form to use).
issues.suggested_fix: Make the attribute names consistent across the problem statement and diagrams. Update the task text to refer to 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents' (matching the UML and solution) or explicitly state that 'inscribedStudents' == 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents' == 'numberOfGuestStudents' to avoid ambiguity.
